The project

A free-to-play mobile merge game: combine sports equipment, build a seasonal card collection, and upgrade the stadiums around town. Ludomancer Studio was contracted by Hermit Crab Game Studio to work on it. I built the stadium upgrade system, the quest and reward system, story cutscenes and game UI, supported the English localization, and tuned a long list of existing systems and mechanics.

What I owned

  • The stadium upgrade system
  • The quest and reward system
  • Story cutscenes
  • Game UI
  • English localization support
  • Balancing and adjustment across many existing systems

A problem I solved

The project had passed through many hands with no agreed architecture, and what was left behind was genuinely hard to work in. A full refactor was not the right call either — the game was heading into large design changes anyway, so rebuilding the foundation would have meant rewriting code that was about to be replaced.

Rather than trying to hold the entire system in my head before touching anything, I learned each system only as deeply as I needed to call into it safely, and wrote my features as new scripts that drove the existing ones. That let me deliver the stadium upgrades, the quest and reward system and the UI without taking on the risk — or the schedule cost — of restructuring code with an uncertain future.

Result

Live on Google Play with 10,000+ downloads and a 4.1-star average from 99 reviews, still receiving updates as of May 2026. The features I owned shipped on schedule in a codebase where that was not a given.

What I'd do differently

Refactor more of it than I did. A lot of the remaining performance headroom was sitting in that architecture, and with what I know now I would have argued harder for spending time there.
